blocks.text: LIVE: Alas Pilipinas vs Kazakhstan – Asian Games 2026 women’s volleyball MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas Women failed to advance to the quarterfinals of the Asian Games 2026 indoor volleyball tournament after falling to Kazakhstan, 29-27, 24-26, 23-25, 19-25, in a must-win game on Thursday at Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Gymnasium in Japan. The explosive offense from Angel Canino and Alyssa Solomon wasn’t enough to send Alas to the next round, as Kazakhstan survived neck-and-neck duels in the first three sets and dominated the fourth with a 21-13 lead off Zhanna Syroyeshkina’s back-to-back aces.
